title: Welcome to Valley Station Church of God
message: We welcome you to Valley Station Church of God, where faith, family, and fellowship come together. Join us as we worship Jesus Christ and grow together in His Word!

title: Happy Thanksgiving
message:
🦃 **NO WEDNESDAY NIGHT BIBLE STUDY**

**Wednesday, November 25, 2026**

In celebration of Thanksgiving, we will not have Wednesday Night Bible Study this week.

We encourage everyone to enjoy this special time with family and loved ones. Take time to count your blessings, make precious memories, and thank God for His goodness and faithfulness!

**“In every thing give thanks.” 1 Thessalonians 5:18 (KJV)**

🍂 **Happy Thanksgiving from your Valley Station Church of God family!**

May your homes be filled with love, laughter, peace, and God's abundant blessings.
